tasks.description:
Phase 0 IMMEDIATE. Block A-02: transcript store with queryable interface. Index by date, domain, speaker. REST endpoint GET /transcripts?domain=&from=&to=. Feeds Block B signal production. Deploy to voxight-api.vercel.app.

Project root: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight
Target file to CREATE: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight/src/routes/transcripts.js
Also MODIFY: /Users/tarekmnif/Documents/Voxight/src/server.js to register the new route.
Build GET /api/transcripts with query params: domain, from (ISO date), speaker.
Query Supabase transcripts table. Apply x402 payment gate ($0.03 USDC).
Return paginated JSON array of transcript objects with timestamps.
Use same pattern as routes/space.js for structure.
